meta_title: Steve Turner Plumbing | Emergency Plumber Stoke-on-Trent
meta_description: Steve Turner Plumbing provides emergency plumbing repairs, installations, and maintenance across Stoke-on-Trent. Fast response, honest pricing. Call 07815 543501 today.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown? Steve Turner arrives fast, diagnoses the problem honestly, and fixes it right first time.
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to new installations, we handle every plumbing job with speed and integrity.

services.title: Emergency Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaking radiators, blocked drains — we're on-call day and night. Most jobs diagnosed and fixed the same day, with parts carried on the van.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: New boiler fit or repair of your existing system. All work comes with a guarantee and we'll help you find the best energy-efficient option for your home.

services.title: Central Heating Upgrades
services.desc: Increase your home's warmth and cut heating bills with new radiators, pipework, or a complete heating system overhaul.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: New tap installations, shower plumbing, and under-sink work. We work cleanly and tidy up fully before we leave.

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Unblocking
services.desc: Slow drains or complete blockages cleared fast using specialist equipment. We locate the problem and clear it without unnecessary digging.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Water pooling under the kitchen or damp patches on walls? We find the source and fix it before it causes damage to your property.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was fed up seeing cowboys overcharge my neighbours.
about_para_1: Steve Turner has been a hands-on plumber in Stoke-on-Trent for over 15 years. He trained as an apprentice and has built his reputation the old-fashioned way — turning up on time, doing the job properly, and charging a fair price. He still answers the phone himself and often does the work himself too.
about_para_2: Hundreds of local homeowners and landlords trust Steve because he listens before he sells. He'll tell you if a small repair will do, not push you toward an expensive replacement. Word-of-mouth referrals account for most of his new customers — a fact he's genuinely proud of.
reviews_heading: What Stoke-on-Trent Homeowners Say About Steve Turner Plumbing

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe at half eleven on a Saturday night. Rang Steve in absolute panic and he was here before midnight. Fixed it, explained what went wrong, and didn't rip me off on the bill. Absolute lifesaver. Will use him for everything from now on.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Steve fitted a new boiler for us last spring. He was knowledgeable, tidy, and honest about what we needed. No upselling. The boiler runs beautifully and our heating bills have dropped noticeably. Couldn't ask for better service.
reviews.author: Jennifer K.

reviews.text: Recommended Steve to my parents after he sorted our radiator leak. He came quickly, did brilliant work, and they've just asked him back to upgrade their whole heating system. This is the type of tradesman you want to keep on speed dial.
reviews.author: Paul W.
